display: Original-resolution tool views of pure pixel-pasted montages; ISO12800 prior, RGGB, exposure1, same ROI [48,48,160,160], identical noisy/exact synthetic GT pixels across six methods per source.
source_selection: First two fixed validation entries, chosen by the existing suite before prediction; not selected using model output or partial metrics.

source_observations.scene: Paraglider canopy and fine suspension lines against orange sky
observations: All joint models remove the visible synthetic grain and retain the canopy outline.
Fine suspension lines remain visibly much weaker than the exact clean target across all six methods. Their recoverability at this noise level is not established by this crop.
The new controls show some broad color variation in the smooth orange region; these views do not establish a clear V95-over-V43 advantage.

source_observations.scene: Glass building, balcony rails and clouds
observations: All four joint models preserve window divisions and balcony geometry more clearly than the two observed-input-only RawNIND adapters in these views.
Cloud wisps and fine rail detail remain softer than the exact clean target.
Differences among V43/V93/V94/V95 are subtle here; this single scene does not establish the desired new-model improvement.

next_action: Continue the unchanged full seven-stage evaluation and inspect weak-detail, color, measured-CFA and GFX panels before any ranking or promotion.
